meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加本地 Ollama 服务，容器代理可直接调用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的容器代理需要调用本地 Ollama 模型，又不想手动折腾配置
copy.tagline_en: Connect your container agent to local Ollama models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent needs to call local Ollama models and you'd prefer a straightforward setup

howto.what: 安装了本技能后，Claude 可以把一些任务交给电脑上的本地 Ollama 模型处理，比如列出已安装的模型、让指定模型生成回答；如果额外开启管理功能，还能下载、删除模型、查看模型详情。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求使用本地 Ollama 模型回答问题时触发，例如要求列出、拉取或删除模型，或询问已加载的模型等。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国的首都。
哪些 ollama 模型当前加载在内存里？

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can delegate work to local Ollama models: list installed models, generate a response from a chosen model, and (if enabled) pull/delete models or inspect model details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks Claude to use local Ollama models, e.g. to answer a question, list/pull/delete models, or check which models are currently loaded.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists available models, then calls ollama_generate to answer.
Claude calls ollama_pull_model to download it.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are loaded in memory now?
